_comment: Fog of war terrain occlusion (phase 1 of docs/fog-of-war-design.md, #1565): player Cavalry (uid 0, sight 420 wu) deployed at (1420, 450) surveys the field under fog of war. Enemy uid 1 at (1275, 640) is deployed south of the hill at Rect2(1150, 380, 250, 200); at ticks 15, 60, and 150, the line of sight passes directly through the hill and the enemy is occluded and hidden despite being within the 420-wu sight radius (distance 239 wu). At tick 8, the player orders the cavalry south to (1420, 700); as the cavalry advances, clear line of sight opens past the hill shoulder and enemy uid 1 is revealed by tick 250.
